aim.core_purpose: Figma-style real-time collaborative canvas where hundreds can draw simultaneously without conflicts
aim.target_audience: Real-time collaboration tool and whiteboard web application builders

primary_features: CRDT-based concurrent drawing conflict prevention and real-time cursor broadcasting
60FPS infinite canvas zoom & pan hardware-accelerated rendering
Offline drawing with automatic change merge on reconnection
critical_rules: Canvas redraw must only run inside requestAnimationFrame loop to eliminate jank
WebSocket message payload sent as binary (ArrayBuffer) or compressed JSON to save bandwidth
logic.directory_structure:
src/
├── components/canvas/
│   ├── Whiteboard.tsx
│   └── CursorOverlay.tsx
├── party/server.ts
└── hooks/useMultiplayer.ts

validation.done_criteria: Two browsers drawing simultaneously show < 30ms latency and 100% render sync
test_cases: 5s network disconnect simulation followed by reconnect restores canvas state
10,000 shapes rendered without frame drop below 50FPS
